request.query: Summarize the documented prerequisites for a privileged role assignment.

response.answer:
Documented prerequisites for a privileged role assignment are:
- IAM administrator review.
- A ticket reference.
- Business justification.

For emergency access, the assignment must expire within four hours and undergo post-incident review.

retrieved.content:
# IAM Change Control Policy

- Any privileged role assignment requires IAM admin review.
- Emergency access expires within 4 hours and needs post-incident review.
- Access changes must include ticket reference and business justification.
retrieved.title: IAM Change Control Policy

retrieved.content:
# Support Operations SOP

- Password reset requires identity verification evidence.
- Low-risk info requests can be resolved autonomously.
- Escalate to human for policy ambiguity or high-risk actions.
retrieved.title: Support Operations SOP

retrieved.content:
# Data Governance Guideline

- Customer data deletion requires DPO approval.
- Legal hold must be validated before deletion.
- Deletion workflow must keep immutable audit events.
retrieved.title: Data Governance Guideline

retrieved.content:
# Enterprise Refund Policy

- Refunds below 500 can be auto-approved with reason code.
- Refunds >= 500 require finance manager approval.
- Refunds >= 5000 require fraud review and secondary approval.
- All refund actions must be auditable.
- Refunds are only accepted within 14 days of item arrival
retrieved.title: Enterprise Refund Policy
